# Melis Platform — Developer Documentation

> Melis Platform is an open-source CMS and application platform built on Laminas (ZF2 lineage).
> This documentation targets developers and AI assistants working with the platform.
> License: OSL-3.0. Source: https://github.com/melisplatform

## Key concepts

- Everything is a **Laminas module**. Backoffice modules are listed in `config/melis.module.load.php`.
- The **config tree** (`MelisCoreConfig`) aggregates every module's `app.*.php` files under a `plugins` root, queryable by path or **melis key**.
- The backoffice UI is **config-driven**: pages are trees of **zones**, each zone declares a **forward** (module/controller/action) rendered by `PluginViewController`.
- Two env vars drive every install: `MELIS_PLATFORM` (selects the DB config file) and `MELIS_MODULE` (selects the front-office site module).
- Auth: bcrypt passwords in `melis_core_user`; rights are an **XML allow-list** in `usr_rights` (empty = full access).
- Caching: filesystem caches under `cache/`; clear `cache/melis*` after any config change.
- Schema migrations: **dbdeploy** (per-module numbered deltas) + **Flyway** (project-level SQL).

## Key file paths (in the installed skeleton)

- `config/melis.module.load.php` — ordered backoffice module list
- `config/application.config.php` — app bootstrap, module assembly, config glob paths
- `config/autoload/platforms/<MELIS_PLATFORM>.php` — DB connection per environment
- `vendor/melisplatform/melis-core/src/MelisModuleManager.php` — module assembly
- `vendor/melisplatform/melis-core/src/Module.php` — core bootstrap & MVC listeners
- `vendor/melisplatform/melis-core/src/Service/MelisCoreConfigService.php` — config tree
- `vendor/melisplatform/melis-core/src/Controller/PluginViewController.php` — zone rendering
- `vendor/melisplatform/melis-core/src/Service/MelisCoreAuthService.php` — authentication
- `vendor/melisplatform/melis-core/src/Service/MelisCoreRightsService.php` — rights
- `vendor/melisplatform/melis-engine/src/Service/MelisPageService.php` — CMS page loading
- `vendor/melisplatform/melis-front/src/Listener/MelisFrontSEORouteListener.php` — SEO routing
- `vendor/melisplatform/melis-ai-engine/src/Service/MelisAIEngineAgentService.php` — AI agent runtime
- `vendor/melisplatform/melis-ai-engine/src/Service/MelisAIEngineMcpService.php` — MCP client
